title: Research Summary
description: Compact structured summary of one complete scientific paper, in the spirit of Nature's Research Briefing: a one-page overview that unpacks the work for a broad scientific audience.

sections.name: Citation
sections.guidance: Authors, title, journal or venue, and year, exactly as printed at the beginning of the paper.

sections.name: Research Question
sections.guidance: The question or problem the paper addresses, in one or two sentences.

sections.name: Background
sections.guidance: What was known before and the gap this work fills.

sections.name: Approach
sections.guidance: Data, methods, and design, including software, models, and key parameters.

sections.name: Key Findings
sections.guidance: The main results as bullet points, keeping important numbers.

sections.name: Interpretation
sections.guidance: What the authors conclude from the findings.

sections.name: Strengths
sections.guidance: What makes the work convincing or new.

sections.name: Limitations
sections.guidance: Limitations the authors state; mark any you infer yourself with 'Inferred:'.

sections.name: Implications
sections.guidance: What the work means for the field or for practice.

sections.name: Take-Home Message
sections.guidance: One or two sentences a reader should remember.
